    StartersAmber's party potato skinsCrisp baked potato skins loaded with melted cheddar, sour cream, spring onion and jalapeñoHow to make it6 medium potatoes, about 1.2kg, scrubbed2 tbsp olive oil1 tsp salt1/2 tsp black pepper1/2 tsp smoked paprika150g cheddar, grated150g sour cream3 spring onions, sliced2 tbsp pickled jalapeños, choppedHeat the oven to 200°C, prick the potatoes and bake until tender.Cool until you can handle them.Halve and scoop out most of the flesh, leaving a thin wall.Brush the skins with the oil, season with salt, pepper and paprika and roast, turning once, until crisp.Fill with the cheddar and bake until melted.Top with sour cream, spring onions and jalapeños.Dewey's trailer bar mixPeanuts, cashews and pretzels roasted with butter, brown sugar, smoked paprika and cayenneHow to make it40g butter, melted2 tbsp brown sugar1 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder1/2 tsp cayenne pepper1 tsp salt200g raw peanuts150g raw cashews100g pretzelsHeat the oven to 160°C. Mix the butter with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne and salt.Toss the nuts and pretzels in the butter mix and spread on a lined tray.Roast, stirring every 10 minutes, until golden.Cool on the tray until crisp.MainsWoodsboro motel smash burgersDouble smashed beef patties with melted cheese, onion, pickles and burger sauce on toasted bunsHow to make it600g beef mince, 20 percent fat3 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp tomato sauce1 tbsp yellow mustard1 tbsp pickle brine4 soft burger buns20g butter1 onion, very finely sliced1 tsp salt1/2 tsp black pepper8 slices of burger cheese1 cup iceberg lettuce, shredded1/2 cup dill pickles, slicedRoll the mince into 8 balls and keep cold.Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, mustard and pickle brine.Toast the cut sides of the buns in the butter.Heat a heavy pan until very hot. In batches, put in the balls, top with a little onion and smash flat. Season with salt and pepper, cook until deeply browned, flip, add cheese and cook a minute more.Build the buns with sauce, lettuce, two patties each and pickles.Mindy's movie rules pepperoni pizzaMindy explains the rules of a requel while the pizza goes coldHow to make it2 large pizza bases200ml tomato passata1 tsp dried oregano250g mozzarella, grated120g pepperoni, sliced1/2 red onion, thinly sliced1 tsp chilli flakes100g rocket1 tbsp olive oilHeat the oven to 240°C with the trays inside.Spread the bases with passata and oregano, then top with mozzarella, pepperoni and onion.Bake until crisp and bubbling.Scatter with chilli flakes and serve with rocket dressed with oil.SweetsRequel browniesFudgy dark chocolate brownies with a raspberry swirl and a crackly topHow to make it200g dark chocolate150g butter250g caster sugar3 eggs1 tsp vanilla extract80g plain flour30g cocoa powder1/4 tsp salt2 tbsp raspberry jam125g raspberries, fresh or frozenHeat the oven to 175°C and line a 20cm square tin.Melt the chocolate with the butter.Whisk the sugar, eggs and vanilla until pale and thick.Fold in the chocolate, then the flour, cocoa and salt.Pour into the tin, dot with jam and raspberries and swirl with a skewer.Bake until just set in the middle.Cool completely in the tin before cutting.DrinksMacher house cherry rum and colaDark rum over ice with muddled cherries and lime, topped with colaHow to make it150g cherries, pitted, fresh or frozen1 lime, juiced3 cups ice180ml dark rum800ml cola, chilled1 lime, cut into wedgesMuddle the cherries with the lime juice in four tall glasses.Fill with ice and add the rum.Top with cola, stir and finish with a lime wedge.
